events.source: SEC 8-K Item 1.03 Bankruptcy or Receivership, accession 0001193125-22-310173, filed 2022-12-21（已对文档正文核实："On December 21, 2022, Core Scientific, Inc. ... filed voluntary petitions for relief under Chapter 11"；2026-11-20 事件核实流水线独立复核一致）
events.note: Core Scientific 于 2022-12-21 自愿申请 Chapter 11；2024 年完成重组并重新上市。同一集集内的退市通知（2022-12-22 8-K）视为冗余，未单独入库。

events.note: Cipher Mining 在矿业寒冬中收到纳斯达克合规通知（2022-12-15）；后经补救未实际退市。作为信用事件登记的是「收到通知」这一披露事实。

events.source: SEC 8-K Item 3.01 Notification of Failure to Satisfy a Continued Listing Rule or Standard, accession 0001493152-20-006932, filed 2020-04-22（事件核实流水线 2026-11-20 对文档正文核实："On April 20, 2020, Marathon Patent Group, Inc. ..."）
